prior_blockers_status.FND-T1-02: REOPENED_AS_P2 (PARTIAL - Parent event adapter remediated, child event adapter has duplicate catchup defect)

findings.title: Unsynchronized currentText in DurableChildEventAdapter Emits Duplicate Full-Text Delta at contentIndex 0 on Subsequent Turns
findings.evidence: In DurableChildEventAdapter, field declaration currentText was removed in favor of contentBlocks Map, and message_update no longer updates this.currentText. However, in message_end (lines 125-138), the code still checks fullText.startsWith(this.currentText) and fullText.length > this.currentText.length. At the end of turn 1, this.currentText = '' is assigned dynamically. On turn 2, fullText.startsWith('') evaluates to true and fullText.length > 0 evaluates to true, causing message_end to slice the entire fullText from 0 and broadcast a duplicate delta of the entire turn output at hardcoded contentIndex: 0. Empirically verified in probe-re-review.test.ts (PROBE 5).
findings.impact: Child subagent streams on multi-turn conversations broadcast duplicate full-text output deltas at contentIndex 0 during message_end, corrupting child streaming output.

findings.title: Stale currentText Fallback in DurableEventAdapter message_end
findings.evidence: In DurableEventAdapter.case 'message_end', if entry.model[0].content is undefined, it attempts fallback let content = msg.content ?? [{ type: 'text', text: this.currentText }]. Because this.currentText was removed from the class, this evaluates to undefined rather than pulling from this.contentBlocks. While standard native Pi entries provide model[0].content, this residual fallback reference is stale.
findings.impact: If an unconventional entry arrives without content, text evaluates to undefined and an undeclared property this.currentText = '' is dynamically attached.
